method.method_draft: 1) First read the image as a static structure and ignore all curved arrows and H labels, per the prompt. 2) Identify the core as a five-membered ring. 3) Map the left exocyclic carbonyl to C(=O) within the ring. 4) Map each EtO2C label to the ester fragment C(=O)OCC attached to the corresponding ring carbon. 5) Map the two right-side OH groups to O substituents. 6) Replace the two unspecified R positions by * atoms. 7) Write the ring once in SMILES with the correct closures and substituent order, yielding *C1(O)C(C(=O)OCC)C(=O)C(C(=O)OCC)C1(*)O.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个带有弯箭头的过渡态结构；按题意忽略所有弯箭头和显式 H 标注。静态结构的主体是一个五元环，左侧环原子处有一个羰基 O=，上左和下左两个环碳各连有 EtO2C 取代基，右侧两个环碳各连有 OH 取代基，并分别带有 R 与 R1 位置。推理：将五元环写成 SMILES 环闭合形式；左侧环内羰基对应环上的 C(=O)；两个 EtO2C 均展开为 C(=O)OCC；两个 OH 写为 O 取代基；R 和 R1 都是不指定基团，按方法用 * 表示。按环顺序组合得到 SMILES：*C1(O)C(C(=O)OCC)C(=O)C(C(=O)OCC)C1(*)O。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the ring skeleton in the image: a 5-membered cyclic framework, one carbonyl on the left side of the ring, two ethoxycarbonyl substituents labeled EtO2C on the two left-side ring carbons, two hydroxyl groups on the right-side carbons, and two unlabeled substituent points marked R and R1 that must become wildcard atoms.
planner_metadata.text_role: The text only instructs to choose the SMILES of the transition-state structure shown and to ignore arrows, so it supplies the output format and the key rule that arrows are not part of the answer.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use chemistry notation knowledge: EtO2C corresponds to C(=O)OCC, OH becomes O, and unspecified R/R1 positions in the answer are represented with * in SMILES. Also use standard SMILES ring-closure numbering for the five-membered ring.
